caption: The drawing depicts a quilt composed of 25 square blocks arranged in a 5-by-5 grid. Each block contains a distinct design, primarily featuring motifs of flowers, birds, baskets, and foliage. The colors used are mainly red, blue, green, and yellow, with pink and cream tones serving as background and border elements. The squares are separated by pink and red sashing, creating a lattice pattern throughout the quilt. The outer edge of the quilt has a scalloped green border, followed inside by a wavy white border, a narrow pink border, and another thin white border. The overall composition is symmetrical, with each square filled with intricate, stylized botanical or animal forms. The entire quilt is set against a plain light beige background.
title: Applique Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
